MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The rubber grommets fit the work suggested by my drill bits and fasteners: protecting wires where they pass through drilled panels feels like a useful next step.",
    "Rectangular magnets and repair glue offer practical alternatives to the adhesive strips, mounting tape, and epoxy I have used, depending on whether I need removable mounting or a small repair.",
    "Cutting and grinding supplies connect with my recent cutting-wheel purchase, although I would need to check the wheel size and my remaining supplies before choosing this set."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Shopping bags and two dozen spray heads serve packaging or replenishment needs I have not shown; owning dropper bottles does not mean I need bulk spraying supplies.",
    "Calibration weights and a pH meter solve different problems from my caliper and thermometer. I need a reason to weigh precisely or test acidity before those tools become useful.",
    "The rod magnets are less suited to the mounting use I have in mind than the rectangular magnets, and the crimp connectors would need a specific wiring job to justify buying the assortment now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been read as broad interest in any workshop or industrial supply, when I choose items for particular repair, mounting, and fabrication tasks.",
    "Buying several hardware assortments does not mean every bulk pack is useful to me; the contents still need to support work I expect to do.",
    "My use of measuring tools seems to have been stretched into interest in unrelated kinds of measurement."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "How an item works with my existing supplies matters: wire protection complements drilled panels, while small repair glue fills a different need from bulk epoxy.",
    "Dimensions and compatibility can decide the purchase. My previous cutting wheels were five inches, so I would not assume a four-and-a-half-inch set fits my equipment.",
    "Interest does not always mean I need more supplies now. Remaining stock and a concrete upcoming task matter for wheels and connectors, while magnet shape matters for the mounting job."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognize my practical repair and fabrication interests, but sometimes extend them to supplies whose purpose, fit, or immediate need is missing."
}
